scope_depth_review.assessment: Substantive, coherent, and well scoped. The provider-property wording does not assert that localMemSize is static-only or a complete launch total, and it does not convert 4 KiB into a resident-work-group ceiling. The only material attribution correction is that the architecture guide table is the B580 representative SKU row; it is not a B570 runtime query or B570-specific specification. Zero private/spill entries are correctly treated as properties for this compiled object rather than universal runtime guarantees.

primary_source_audit.verified: On the successful kernel-create callback PTI queries zeKernelGetProperties and copies maxSubgroupSize, numKernelArgs, localMemSize, privateMemSize, spillMemSize, required group size and the experimental register-file extension. PTI prints private/spill numbers literally; zero registerFileSize is the condition that prints “unknown”. The report’s field mapping is consistent with the pinned source.
primary_source_audit.limits: The query is captured at kernel creation and PTI does not record later local argument byte sizes in this properties table. The experimental register field is provider metadata, not active register demand or occupancy. The report-provided file SHA was not independently byte-verified through the browser review; the immutable Git commit and inspected source path were confirmed.

primary_source_audit.verified: The specification defines localMemSize as local memory used by each thread group, privateMemSize as compiler-allocated private memory used by each thread, and spillMemSize as compiler-allocated spill memory. For an SLM argument, zeKernelSetArgumentValue receives the resource byte size through argSize.
primary_source_audit.limits: The API description does not label localMemSize as static-only or define it as the complete per-dispatch sum including later SLM argument values.

primary_source_audit.verified: The programming guide calls zeKernelGetProperties invariant kernel-object properties and describes group size as separately set or defaulted for launch.
primary_source_audit.limits: This supports reading the table as object properties, not actual launch residency; it does not independently specify how each SYCL local accessor is lowered or accounted by the driver.

primary_source_audit.verified: The Xe2-HPG column lists 128 KiB SLM per Xe-core, 128 KiB maximum SLM per work-group, maximum work-group size 1,024, subgroups 16/32, and 128/256 GRFs per thread in regular/large register mode. The table uses B580 as its representative Xe2-HPG model and says the table describes one popular model per microarchitecture.
primary_source_audit.limits: It is a B580 representative hardware row, not a B570 SKU-specific local-memory query. Do not state its capacities as measured or queried B570 values without corroboration.

primary_source_audit.verified: Intel lists B570 as Xe2 with 18 Xe-cores and 144 vector engines.
primary_source_audit.limits: The page does not publish B570 SLM capacity, per-work-group SLM maximum, work-group limit, or runtime occupancy.

primary_source_audit.verified: The guide describes SLM as Xe-core local and work-group shared, and says the amount available to a work-group is device-dependent and may depend on work-group size.
primary_source_audit.limits: It gives no exact B570 allocation rounding, reservations, or active-work-group residency for this kernel.

corrections.type: SKU scope of public capacity evidence
corrections.finding: The architecture guide table cited at report line 39 is explicitly the Xe2-HPG representative B580 row, while the captured device is B570. The B570 SKU page confirms Xe2 and core/vector-engine counts but does not establish the table’s SLM/work-group figures as B570-specific values.
corrections.action: When reusing lines 39–41 or 52, call 128 KiB/core and 128 KiB/work-group the published B580/Xe2-HPG reference figures, not a same-run B570 query. Keep exact B570 limits pending runtime query or SKU-specific authoritative evidence. This correction does not change the no-occupancy/no-bottleneck conclusion.

corrections.severity: retrieval guardrail; report wording is appropriately bounded
corrections.finding: The Level Zero API says localMemSize is per-thread-group local memory, and SLM argument bytes are supplied via argSize. The PTI capture queries properties at successful kernel creation and does not capture the later per-launch local-argument sizes. Available evidence does not classify the 4,096-byte value as static-only or as a complete launch total.
corrections.action: Read 4,096 B only as this kernel object’s reported localMemSize at creation. Do not add it to the 44,500-byte source estimate, subtract, or use either to compute resident groups. Collect actual local argument sizes and launch group size if the qualified component diagnostic needs a total.

corrections.severity: retrieval guardrail; no report correction required
corrections.finding: PTI emits privateMemSize and spillMemSize as numeric values, including zero. Its special “unknown” text path applies to registerFileSize equal to zero. Thus the row’s zeroes are reported values for this compiled object, not a universal all-input guarantee and not a basis to relabel the fields undefined.
corrections.action: Preserve the report’s object/specialization scope and its no-runtime-guarantee caveat. Do not turn zero private/spill metadata into an all-launch no-spill or residency claim.
